card.name: Linking words before place names
card.fires_on: Mostly a verb or small linking word (visited, into, in, of, at, and) right before a country or city name in news or history text. Weaker hits appear inside drug abbreviations.

modes.label: Link before a place
modes.description: A verb or preposition that comes just before a country, city or other place name.
modes.example: a German doctor who worked on Tiger Island and is perhaps the first man in this country to have grasped the importance of clean water to public health,<< visited>> Georgetown in the 1790

modes.label: Inside drug abbreviations
modes.description: Part of a drug name or abbreviation in label text, such as cobicistat (COBI) or a progestin name.
